QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: offlineEditingFirmwareClass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Offline editing firmware class
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Offline editing firmware class

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: offlineEditingVehicleClass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Offline editing vehicle class
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Offline editing vehicle class

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: offlineEditingCruiseSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Offline editing cruise speed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: This value defines the default speed for calculating mission statistics for vehicles which do not support hover or VTOL vehicles in fixed wing mode. It does not modify the flight speed for a specific flight plan.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Offline editing cruise speed

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: offlineEditingHoverSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Offline editing hover speed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: This value defines the default speed for calculating mission statistics for multi-rotor vehicles or VTOL vehicle in multi-rotor mode. It does not modify the flight speed for a specific flight plan.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Offline editing hover speed

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: offlineEditingAscentSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Offline editing ascent speed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: This value defines the ascent speed for multi-rotor vehicles for use in calculating mission duration.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Offline editing ascent speed

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: offlineEditingDescentSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Offline editing descent speed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: This value defines the cruising speed for multi-rotor vehicles for use in calculating mission duration.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Offline editing descent speed

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: batteryPercentRemainingAnnounce
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Announce battery remaining percent
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Announce the remaining battery percent when it falls below the specified percentage.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Announce battery remaining percent

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: defaultMissionItemAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Default altitude automatically assigned to new waypoints during mission planning.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: This value specifies the default altitude for new items added to a mission.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Default Mission Altitude

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: audioMuted
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Mute audio output
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Mutes all audio output without changing the volume level.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Mute Audio Output

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: audioVolume
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Controls the volume level for audio alerts and notifications.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Sets the audio output volume percentage.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Audio Output Volume

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: virtualJoystick
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Displays an on-screen virtual joystick in the Fly view for manual vehicle control.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: If this option is enabled the virtual joystick will be shown on the Fly view.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Virtual Joystick

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: virtualJoystickAutoCenterThrottle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Returns the throttle stick to center when released instead of holding position.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: If enabled the throttle stick will snap back to center when released.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Auto-Center Throttle

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: virtualJoystickLeftHandedMode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Swaps the virtual joystick layout so throttle/yaw is on the left.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: If this option is enabled the virtual joystick layout will be reversed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Left-Handed Mode

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gstDebugLevel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Sets the verbosity of video streaming debug logging. Requires restart.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Sets the environment variable GST_DEBUG for all pipeline elements on boot.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Video streaming debug

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: useChecklist
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Enables the preflight checklist to help verify system status before flight.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: If this option is enabled the preflight checklist will be used.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Use Preflight Checklist

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enforceChecklist
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Prevents the vehicle from arming until all preflight checklist items pass.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: If this option is enabled the preflight checklist must pass before arming.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enforce Preflight Checklist

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enableMultiVehiclePanel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Shows a panel for managing multiple connected vehicles simultaneously.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Enable Multi-Vehicle Panel when multiple vehicles are connected.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable Multi-Vehicle Panel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uiScalePercent
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Scales the entire user interface including fonts and controls.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Scales the entire user interface relative to the platform default. 100% is the default size.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: UI Scaling

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: indoorPalette
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Switches between light and dark color schemes for different lighting conditions.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The color scheme for the user interface.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Color Scheme

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: savePath
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Directory where mission files, logs, and other application data are saved.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Directory to which all data files are saved/loaded from
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Application Load/Save Path

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: androidDontSaveToSDCard
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Don't save to SD card, even if available
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: If this option is enabled, application data will not be saved to the SD card.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Don't save to SD card, even if available

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: tiandituToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 用于访问 TianDiTu 地图瓦片的个人 API 令牌。
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: 你的 TianDiTu 地图个人访问令牌
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: TianDiTu

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: mapboxToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 用于访问 Mapbox 地图瓦片和样式的个人 API 令牌。
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: 你的 Mapbox 地图个人访问令牌
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Mapbox

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: mapboxAccount
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 用于访问账号专属地图资源的 Mapbox 账号用户名。
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: 你的 Mapbox 地图个人账号名
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: 账号

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: mapboxStyle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 控制 Mapbox 地图瓦片外观的地图样式 ID。
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Mapbox 地图设计样式 ID
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: 地图样式

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: esriToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 用于访问 Esri 地图服务的个人 API 令牌。
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: 你的 Esri 地图个人访问令牌
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Esri

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: customURL
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 自定义地图瓦片服务器 URL，支持 {x}、{y}、{z} 替换项。
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: XYZ 地图 URL，支持 {x} {y} {z} 或 {zoom} 替换项。例如：https://basemaps.linz.govt.nz/v1/tiles/aerial/EPSG:3857/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?api=d01ev80nqcjxddfvc6amyvkk1ka
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: 服务器 URL

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: vworldToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 用于访问 VWorld 地图瓦片的个人 API 令牌。
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: 你的 VWorld 地图个人访问令牌
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: VWorld

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: openaipToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 用于显示 OpenAIP 空域和航空数据的个人 API 密钥。
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: 你的 OpenAIP 航空地图个人 API 密钥。可在 https://www.openaip.net 获取
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: OpenAIP

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: followTarget
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Streams the ground station GPS location to the vehicle for Follow Me mode.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Never,Always,When in Follow Me Flight Mode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Stream GCS Position

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: qLocaleLanguage
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Determines the language used for the application interface. Requires restart.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.comment: QLocale::Language id. Fact enum metadata is setup in AppSettings code. QGC reboot required in order to load new json translations into FactMetaData.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Language

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: clearSettingsNextBoot
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Resets all application preferences to their defaults on the next launch.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, all application settings will be reset to defaults on the next start.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Clear all settings on next start

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: disableAllPersistence
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Disable all data persistence
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: If this option is set, nothing will be saved to disk.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Disable all data persistence

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: firstRunPromptIdsShown
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Comma separated list of first run prompt ids which have already been shown.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Comma separated list of first run prompt ids which have already been shown.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: favoriteParameters
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Comma separated list of favorite parameter names.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Comma separated list of favorite parameter names.
